race.comment: TRI TIME (9) is a promising colt who made it two from two with an easy win in a Breeders Challenge heat at Bathurst. Draws for a trail and can continue on his winning way. GOCCIADORO (10) stuck on well and finished runner-up when second-up in a Breeders Challenge heat at this circuit and distance last time. Draws on the back row but should be close to his peak third up. TEDDY LOU (8) will be fitter for a resuming third when behind GOCCIADORO. Draws wide but won his other two outings, both at this circuit and distance. HES A DANCER (6) was down the track last time but came from wider than this to miss narrowly here prior.
